author.heading: About Terry Pratchett
author.bio: Pratchett’s Discworld novels use comic fantasy to examine human institutions and habits. Reaper Man makes Death’s removal from his job the starting point for a story about mortality and the disruption of ordinary life.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Reaper Man describes a person’s continuing effects on the world through the image of ripples. The popular substitution of “actually” for “finally” is small but real; both the novel transcription and the specialist quotation history preserve “finally.”
